neighbours.label: the sentence-opening ' The' after a full stop in running prose
fire: Snow fell all night. The plows came at dawn.
She closed the shop. The street was empty by then.
Prices kept rising. The council did nothing about it.
We missed the bus. The next one came an hour later.
They sold the farm. The buyers were from out of state.
He read the letter twice. The news was not good.
Rain ruined the game. The fans went home early.
I opened the window. The air smelled of smoke.
quiet: Snow fell all night and the plows came at dawn.
She closed the shop when the street was empty.
Prices kept rising while the council did nothing.
We missed the bus and the next one came later.
They sold the farm to the buyers from out of state.
He read the letter twice but the news was not good.
Rain ruined the game so the fans went home early.
I opened the window and the air smelled of smoke.
